Dataset: BTS Airline On-Time Performance, Jan-Jun 2024
Domain: Transportation
Source: https://www.transtats.bts.gov (Reporting Carrier On-Time Performance)
Description: US domestic flights reported by certified carriers (non-cancelled, non-diverted), Jan-Jun 2024. One record per flight.

Columns to validate:
  DepDelay (numeric): Departure delay in minutes; negative means early
  TaxiOut (numeric): Taxi-out time in minutes
  AirTime (numeric): Airborne time in minutes
  Distance (numeric): Distance between airports in miles
  Reporting_Airline (text / categorical): Two-character IATA code of the reporting carrier
  Origin (text / categorical): Three-letter IATA code of the origin airport
  OriginState (text / categorical): Two-letter US state or territory code of the origin airport
Identifying columns (not validated): FlightDate, Flight_Number_Reporting_Airline, Dest, CRSDepTime

Write the validation rules for the columns above (and for whole records where useful). Return JSON only.
